lead: A content card with structure only: padding, outline and shadow are all up to the theme style.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `outline` draws a border, `filled` a grey background, `elevated` a shadow.

api.title: API Reference
api.parts: `Card.Header` / `Card.Title` / `Card.Description` / `Card.Body` / `Card.Footer` are structural parts with no props of their own (they take the HTML attributes of their element); all of them can be left out.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `card.css`; Ant Design's header has a divider, HeroUI's doesn't.
styling.card: The frame: padding, outline, radius and background
styling.header: The header with its title and description
styling.body: The content and the footer actions
